step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows an internal developer platform (Orion portal) workflow. A developer accesses Route 53 for DNS resolution, routing traffic to an Application Load Balancer (ALB). ALB directs requests to an Amazon EKS cluster running on EC2 Spot Instances. When environment provisioning jobs run, state change events are sent to Amazon SNS, fan-out to Amazon SQS, and monitored back by workers on Spot instances to recover disrupted jobs seamlessly.
